items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: I know her. I'm not personally acquainted with her.

ctx.x: You know, Lizzy says she's not going to sing anymore now. No? Yeah, I saw her about three weeks ago and she said she wants to retire. And she's going to devote her time to the church. You know, she's been very religious. Oh yeah, I know because my wife was very religious.

And my wife used to meet her in church all the time. Really? I know her. I'm not personally acquainted with her. But I found out where she lived and I was just trying to go out there, pay her a visit. And knowing that she used to sing those creoles for her, I thought maybe I could...
